description: Diff two quarterly 13F snapshots for an institution. Compares the latest filing against the prior quarter and returns per-position changes: new positions, increased, decreased, and exited. Sorted by |changePercent| descending so the biggest moves surface first. Much more efficient than calling get_institution_holdings twice and diffing client-side — the server computes everything in a single SQL query.

cik.description: SEC CIK number of the institution (e.g., "0001067983" for Berkshire Hathaway)

name: get_institution_position_changes
title: Get Institution Position Changes
